_comment: THE FICTIONAL CAST of the French demo studio (npm run sandbox -- --country FR): eight invented businesses, three trades, one at every stage of the funnel. No real business, person, address or photo: invented towns, reserved .example domains (RFC 2606), phone numbers in the ARCEP ranges reserved for fiction, SVG illustrations made from scratch. The « built » sites are REAL runs of the product (npm run first-site) on their fictional dated sites, kept in examples/. « stage » is the story's own word (French cast), « role » the step the sandbox plays. The default demo (a US studio) gets cast.us.json. « seller »: the studio's fictional business details for Billing (a demo invoice prints whole).
